dmn_you_expired.text: You expired, Jesus, but the source of life gushed forth for souls, and an ocean of mercy opened up for the whole world. O Blood and Water, which gushed forth from the Heart of Jesus as a fountain of mercy for us, I trust in You.
dmn_you_expired.source: Chaplet of the Divine Mercy tradition (reproduced e.g. by the USCCB)

dmn_blood_water.text: O Blood and Water, which gushed forth from the Heart of Jesus as a fountain of mercy for us, I trust in You.
dmn_blood_water.source: Chaplet of the Divine Mercy tradition (reproduced e.g. by the USCCB)

dmn_our_father.text: Our Father, Who art in heaven, hallowed be Thy name; Thy kingdom come; Thy will be done on earth as it is in heaven. Give us this day our daily bread; and forgive us our trespasses as we forgive those who trespass against us; and lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil. Amen.

dmn_hail_mary.text: Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee; blessed art thou amongst women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus. Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.

dmn_apostles_creed.text: I believe in God, the Father Almighty, Creator of heaven and earth; and in Jesus Christ, His only Son, our Lord; who was conceived by the Holy Spirit, born of the Virgin Mary, suffered under Pontius Pilate, was crucified, died, and was buried. He descended into hell; the third day He arose again from the dead. He ascended into heaven, sits at the right hand of God, the Father Almighty; from thence He shall come to judge the living and the dead. I believe in the Holy Spirit, the holy Catholic Church, the communion of Saints, the forgiveness of sins, the resurrection of the body, and life everlasting. Amen.

dmn_eternal_father.text: Eternal Father, I offer You the Body and Blood, Soul and Divinity of Your Dearly Beloved Son, Our Lord Jesus Christ, in atonement for our sins and those of the whole world.
dmn_eternal_father.source: Chaplet of the Divine Mercy tradition (reproduced e.g. by the USCCB)

dmn_for_the_sake.text: For the sake of His sorrowful Passion, have mercy on us and on the whole world.
dmn_for_the_sake.source: Chaplet of the Divine Mercy tradition (reproduced e.g. by the USCCB)

dmn_glory_be.text: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

dmn_holy_god.text: Holy God, Holy Mighty One, Holy Immortal One, have mercy on us and on the whole world.
dmn_holy_god.source: Chaplet of the Divine Mercy tradition (reproduced e.g. by the USCCB)

dmn_jesus_trust.source: Chaplet of the Divine Mercy tradition (reproduced e.g. by the USCCB)

variants.title: Day 1
variants.intention: All mankind, especially sinners: that the whole world may come to know the mercy of God and trust in it.
variants.source: Chaplet novena tradition (St. Faustina request summaries)

variants.title: Day 2
variants.intention: Priests and religious: that, drawn from the abyss of His mercy, they may bring His pardon to every soul entrusted to them.
variants.source: Chaplet novena tradition (St. Faustina request summaries)

variants.title: Day 3
variants.intention: Devout and faithful souls: that the mercy of God may accompany them on every path of their life.
variants.source: Chaplet novena tradition (St. Faustina request summaries)

variants.title: Day 4
variants.intention: Those who do not believe in God and those who do not yet know Him: that the light of His mercy may shine upon their darkness.
variants.source: Chaplet novena tradition (St. Faustina request summaries)

variants.title: Day 5
variants.intention: Souls separated from the Church: that the charity of God may gather every straying soul back into one fold.
variants.source: Chaplet novena tradition (St. Faustina request summaries)

variants.title: Day 6
variants.intention: Meek and humble souls and the souls of little children: that their innocence may draw down the mercy of God upon the whole world.
variants.source: Chaplet novena tradition (St. Faustina request summaries)

variants.title: Day 7
variants.intention: Souls who venerate His mercy: that, dwelling in the merciful Heart of Jesus, they may draw from it all that they need.
variants.source: Chaplet novena tradition (St. Faustina request summaries)

variants.title: Day 8
variants.intention: Souls in purgatory: that the mercy of God may refresh them in their trial and open heaven to them in due time.
variants.source: Chaplet novena tradition (St. Faustina request summaries)

variants.title: Day 9
variants.intention: Lukewarm souls: that, kindled by the fire of His mercy, they may make an act of perfect trust in Jesus.
variants.source: Chaplet novena tradition (St. Faustina request summaries)
